method.source: Exact Python PEP files at the retained pre-2020 archive anchor. Require an explicit public-domain or CC0 notice in each file, a named credited author, and two disjoint five-sentence plain-prose excerpts with valid eight-word geometry.
method.roster: Hash order by PEP number. Exclude earlier PEPs and exact 12-word overlaps with the retained inventories. Exclude repeated recorded authors across the previous phrase study, earlier PEPs and the held role. Qualify source only before any generator or classifier call. Each ordinary control is a same-work substitution.
method.points: Reuse all three archived Kubernetes operating points exactly, including the original 0.50 current-window point. No held recalibration. Recompute the older points from their already committed response packet in separate audit.
method.advancement: At least two additional held work groups across both generators with at most one extra human group when combined with the current arm. At least six admitted edits per generator.
